answer: Each new agent must solve a verifiable delay function before it can trade: a strictly sequential computation no parallel hardware can speed up, like water boring a karst channel one drop at a time. An honest agent pays this once and amortizes it over months, but a sybil operator spinning up a thousand clones must grind every VDF end to end, as slow as a glacier. Each proof is stamped like a pigment that cannot be forged or reused, so attacker cost scales linearly per fake identity.
